name: ternix
description: Self-hosted SSH client with end-to-end encrypted shared vaults

scripts.build:packages: corepack pnpm run build:core && corepack pnpm --filter @ternix/ssh build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" run typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" run test
